purpose: Acceptance specifications for manual review; not yet executable semantic evaluation fixtures

cases.required_evidence: Dated issuer operating data; scenario inputs and price availability
cases.expected_failure_or_decision_behavior: Do not invent consensus or call scenario assumptions facts

cases.scenario: Lower discount rates but weaker sales
cases.required_evidence: Official rates release plus issuer transmission exposure
cases.expected_failure_or_decision_behavior: Explain competing channels; retain unknown exposure

cases.scenario: Proposed restrictions with unavailable segment detail
cases.required_evidence: Dated policy status and issuer geographic/segment disclosure
cases.expected_failure_or_decision_behavior: Proposal is not enacted policy; no numeric haircut from headline

cases.scenario: Concentrated ETF compared with a company
cases.required_evidence: Dated holdings, costs, concentration, benchmark mapping
cases.expected_failure_or_decision_behavior: M1 rejects ETF mandate; M2 requires ETF-specific analysis

cases.required_evidence: Typed retrieval failure, optional successful source
cases.expected_failure_or_decision_behavior: Critical gap blocks affected conclusion; receipt retained

cases.required_evidence: Separate observed/retrieved/publication times and child manifest
cases.expected_failure_or_decision_behavior: M1 stays unpublished; M3 must refresh and invalidate dependencies
